mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, r.id FROM roles r WHERE r.code = 'MEMBER' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.code IN ('MEMBER', 'LEADER', 'PM') ORDER BY CASE r.code WHEN 'PM' THEN 1 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1
